cards.claim: Muon consistently outperforms AdamW in vision transformer training
cards.conditions: ImageNet-100 and Pl@ntNet-300K datasets; ViT models; standard vision recipes with mixup, cutmix, smoothing, and random augmentation
cards.effect: Muon shows consistent improvements over AdamW; especially large gains on long-tailed Pl@ntNet macro top-1
cards.evidence: Empirical comparison experiments across multiple datasets and augmentation settings
cards.quote: Muon consistently outperforms AdamW, with especially large gains on long-tailed Pl@ntNet macro top-1.

cards.claim: Muon's performance gains are recipe-dependent; Muon benefits much more than AdamW from heavy data augmentation
cards.conditions: ViT training with varying augmentation techniques (mixup, cutmix, random erasing); ImageNet-100 and Pl@ntNet-300K
cards.effect: Muon gains amplified under advanced augmentation; differential sensitivity between Muon and AdamW
cards.evidence: Comparative experiments with and without augmentation
cards.quote: These gains are also recipe-dependent, where Muon benefits much more than AdamW from advanced and significant data augmentation techniques.

cards.claim: Removing heavy augmentation induces late-training spectral concentration and mode collapse in gradient matrices, particularly in deep MLP-down blocks during Muon training
cards.conditions: ViT training on Pl@ntNet-300K and ImageNet-100; Muon optimizer; analyzing gradient spectra through training
cards.effect: Spectral concentration and mode collapse in deep MLP blocks without heavy augmentation
cards.evidence: Spectral analysis of gradient matrices throughout training runs
cards.quote: Within Muon training runs, removing heavy data augmentation induces a late-training spectral concentration and mode collapse in gradient matrices, primarily in deep MLP-down blocks.

cards.claim: Under fixed augmentation, Muon spreads gradient energy across more singular modes than AdamW, particularly in QKV (attention) gradients
cards.conditions: ViT models with full augmentation recipe; comparing gradient structure between Muon and AdamW
cards.effect: Muon creates broader spectral basis (more singular modes); AdamW gradient energy remains concentrated in narrow basis
cards.evidence: Spectral analysis and singular-value decomposition of gradient matrices in attention projections
cards.quote: Under a fixed "full" augmentation recipe, the clearest Muon-AdamW contrast appears instead in QKV gradients, where AdamW gradient energy remains concentrated in a much narrower basis while Muon spreads energy across substantially more singular modes.

cards.claim: Muon in ViTs should be understood as an optimizer-recipe interaction; recipe is critical for preventing spectral pathology
cards.conditions: ViT training with variable augmentation and training recipes
cards.effect: Full augmentation recipes prevent mode collapse and spectral concentration in Muon training; this interaction is central to Muon's behavior
cards.evidence: Gradient spectral analysis and ablations of augmentation techniques
cards.quote: Muon in ViTs is therefore best understood as an optimizer-recipe interaction. Under a fixed recipe, Muon differs from AdamW most clearly in attention projections, where its gradients consist of a broader spectral basis. Within Muon, a full training recipe is important for preventing late spectral concentration and mode collapse in deep feedforward blocks.

cards.claim: Muon outperforms AdamW on image segmentation and masked autoencoder training tasks
cards.conditions: ViT-based models on image segmentation and MAE pretraining; standard training recipes
cards.effect: Muon demonstrates superior performance across all tested vision tasks
cards.evidence: Experiments on segmentation and masked autoencoder models
cards.quote: We further demonstrate efficacy in training ViTs on image segmentation and masked autoencoder models, where Muon outperforms AdamW in all settings considered.
